venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Friday 10/16 (MOD MKZ//JK, entered by Daniel; posted 3:04am 10/17).** Net sales $7,030 vs target $6,941 (+1%). Food $467. 251 guests, $28.01 check avg. Comps $164.20. Smooth start, first major push around 10pm; several Google reviews received during service. Opener cut ~8:30. Draft beer line issue — JK stayed late trying to fix; follow up needed. Last guests out by 2:15. Maintenance: beer draft lines. 86: Grey Goose. Favorite moment: Casi Cielo staff came down for after-work drinks.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Friday 10/16 (MOD/Chef KE, KK, JMS; entered by KE; form dated 10/17, posted 5:17am 10/17).** Net sales $9,485 vs target $12,058 (-21%). Food $259. ~337 guests, $28.17 check avg. Comps $163.20 (1.7%). Steady evening, decent early push, steady until ~midnight; good mix of crowd, cooler air brought out an older/millennial crowd. Small pops in kitchen; John-Michael supported on the floor. 86: Pumpkin Ale until Monday; draft Guinness until Mon/Tue (cans available). Favorite moment: most of the O-Ku team came in after a slow night.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Friday 10/16 (AM MOD Maggie S & Josh; PM Carey & Chef Lucas; entered by Carey).** Net sales incl. events $29,950.52; target not provided (entered '?'). Base net $16,750.52 (DC/AM $1,460.13, D&C PM $15,290.39; Garden closed — 'Good bye Garden'); event sales $13,200 (event food $7,392); total food incl. events $10,408.60. 384 guests (Tock). Comps $856.44 (6.54%). Wedding ceremony/reception for Ashley & Brian, 73 guests, 5–10pm in all spaces — went smoothly. Smooth Friday with many large parties; reservations showing up with more guests than booked is a growing trend to watch.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: On and off rain ahead of severe storms
venues.narrative: **EV — Friday 10/16 (MOD/Chef Kyler/Will; entered by Sean; posted 11:00am 10/17).** Net sales $7,687 vs target $7,853 (-2%). Food $719, beverage $6,942, retail $26. 227 guests, $34 check avg. Comps $151.84. Extremely slow first turn due to storm watch, true Friday pace by second turn; very large waitlist (~25 parties, about half returned). Room still full at 1:45; busier than last Friday. Top sellers: Paper Wasp, Rosalie/Native Lion, Cloudwalk. 1 no-show (charged). Breakage: 1x DOF.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Friday 10/16 (MOD/Chef Gigi, Julian, Joe, Saleh, Josh, Angel; entered by Joe; form dated 10/17, posted 6:09am 10/17).** Net sales $14,077 vs target $11,877 (+19%). Marquee $8,955, Standing Room $5,122; food $2,502; event sales $4,980. 250 guests; check avg $56.31 (net/guests; form reported $138). Comps $260 (Concha, Baldi, Nami, investors, birthday, service recovery, DNL). Busy Friday: 150 covers to start incl. 40 for a private event in Standing Room, room nearly full by 7pm, brief lull 7–8, 10pm party arrived ~10:30, hefty waitlist. No-shows charged.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Friday 10/16 (MOD Josh; form dated 10/17, posted 4:24am 10/17).** Net sales incl. events $8,469.65 vs target $8,970 (-6%). Marquee Bar $7,358.64, Garden $1,344, food $1,037 (form 'Total Sales' $8,702.64). 184 guests, GCA $39.95. Comps $232.99. Slower than typical Friday because of heat then heavy rain; busiest 7–9pm; rain led to longer stays and multiple rounds. Garden picked up ~8:15, last call 10:40. Kitchen top sellers: cookies, fried chicken, bread; James worked solo on line and dish. Improve: pre-bussing, spotting blind spots.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Friday 10/16 (entered by Alexis; posted 1:32am 10/17).** Net sales $11,877 vs target $12,053 (-1%). Municipal Bar AM $1,621, PM $7,154; Sun Club $666; Hot Eye $2,465. Food $3,541. 253 guests (57 AM + 196 PM OpenTable), $46.94 check avg. Comps $240. Strong morning (4 tables early, hotel guests), decent happy hour, then slow evening — one of slowest Fridays in a while (~30 covers to start, low walk-ins). Sun Club slow for a sunny Friday; Hot Eye picked up 9:30–11:30. Two DNLs on crudo.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Friday 10/16 (MOD Curtis; entered by Frank Walline/Curtis Hayes; posted 4:41am 10/17).** Net sales $11,817 vs target $11,522 (+3%). Food $1,542. 99 reservations, 268 guests, $44.09 avg guest spend. Comps $694.39 (5.8%) — high DNLs, F&F, employee discounts, industry friends. Sluggish start until ~7:30, lull ~6pm then big rush; heavy late-night push, nearly all waitlist seated. Maintenance: CFM HVAC for fried circuit board (Monday), drain leak at back bar, carbonator replacement quote via CMA plumbing.
